extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners in legal document review, e-discovery, and explainable machine learning
extracted.subtask_description: Developing and evaluating explainable predictive coding / text classification methods that identify responsive documents and the specific responsive snippets within them to support legal document review (e-discovery).

rubrics_metrics.name: Explainability (human-understandable decisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: In an explainable AI system, actions or decisions are human understandable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper emphasizes that explainability requires that model actions or classification decisions can be interpreted by humans (attorneys/reviewers); this is the central motivating desideratum for explainable predictive coding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsive-snippet justification for document-level labels
rubrics_metrics.description: In typical legal 'document review' scenarios, a document can be identified as responsive, as long as one or more of the text snippets in a document are deemed responsive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because document responsiveness can hinge on localized text, locating the specific responsive snippet(s) is important: if predictive coding can locate these responsive snippets, attorneys could more easily evaluate and trust the model's document classification decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Snippet-localization capability of predictive coding
rubrics_metrics.description: Predictive coding should locate responsive snippets within responsive documents (explainable predictive coding).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The authors propose methods for explainable predictive coding whose objective is to identify the specific snippets that make a document responsive; such localization is presented as the mechanism by which explainability is achieved and attorney review is facilitated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on review efficiency and quality
rubrics_metrics.description: When deployed with defined and explainable results, predictive coding can drastically enhance the overall quality and speed of the document review process by reducing the time it takes to review documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper positions explainable predictive coding not only as a transparency requirement but also as a practical means to improve review throughput and quality in real legal matters; preliminary experimental results using real-case data are reported to support this claim.
